exposure: maternal attitudes (e.g., objection to vaccine timing/necessity)
sources of information about HBV vaccination
outcome: vaccine catch-up rate at 7 weeks postpartum
cohort: Participants were mothers, mostly Jewish white middle-class married multiparous women with some higher education, and their term singleton newborns from a tertiary university-affiliated hospital in Israel.
finding: Multiple sources of vaccine information were significantly associated with newborn non-vaccination, and many mothers objected to the timing and necessity of the vaccine.
